t: This is the Quentin Blake Centre for Illustration, the only public arts organisation in the UK dedicated to illustration. Quentin Blake founded it in 2002, and it carries his name. From 2014 to 2020 it was based at Granary Square in Camden and called House of Illustration. Blake has illustrated over 300 books, including eighteen by Roald Dahl. He was the first British Children's Laureate, and won the Hans Christian Andersen Award in 2002.
